page.layout: One printed page with running head at top ("96 | NOTÆ."); two-column main text, with notes in the left margin running alongside it; a short note block below the left margin at lower left is part of the margin. Main text is in the centre-right column; left margin holds notes (in the upper margin and a lower group). Lower right of main text shows a catchword-like line "hamo" at the foot right.

Quàm pulchrè convenit figmento isti nomen suum, ut sit הבל Vanitas? Quòd si cum nomine suo ad Arabes transferit, erat forsan illis à quibus mutuatum sumpserunt הבעל Habbaal, vel הבל Habbel ḥbl. Arabibus aliàs nomen hoc à themate هبل deductum, obesum, Grandem, vel & atate provectum sonabit: at apud ipsos nominis impositi rationem nondum reperimus. Statua (referente Safioddino) erat ex عقيق احمر effigie hominis, cui dextra amputata, quam ei jacturam ut resarcirent, Koraifhita aureàm substituerunt. & (ni exemplaris non satis fidi mendo fallar) septem sagittas manibus tenebat, verba sunt و القداح وهي سبعة سهم دينه, Quæ (si rectè legatur القداح quod Sagittas nondum aliis & spiculis instructas denotat,) quid aliud sonant quàm, Et Sagitta quæ numero septem, inter manus ejus (i.e. coram eo) vel in manibus ejus? Verum nec de lectione, nec de sensu multum dubitare sinit quod apud AbulFedam aliósque legimus, Mohammedem sc. expugnatâ Mecchâ, anno à fuga octavo, Caabam ingressum reperisse ibi الشخوص على صور الملائكة وصورة ابراهيم وفي يده الازلام يستقسم بها فقال قاتلهم الله جعلوا شيخنا يستقسم بالازلام ما شان ابراهيم والازلام ثم امر بتلك الصور فطمست i. e. Effigies formâ * Angelorum, & figuram Abrahami manu sua sagittas ad sortitionem aptas tenentis, [iisque visis] dixisse. Perdat illos Deus Senem nostrum sagittis sortientem finxerunt. Quid Abra-

page.notes: Left margin notes are set in small italic type: "v. & Iannab. An. Heir. 8°." (top), "* i. e. Lapide Achate rubro." (middle, marked with asterisk in text), and "ꝏ و غيرهم aliorúmque Allannab. صور الاذلام i. e. figuras prophetarum. Camel." (lower). The Arabic and Hebrew are transcribed as best read; the Arabic of the lower-right block and the Hebrew words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The line "Quid Abra-/hamo" is continued at the foot right as "hamo" (catchword). Several Arabic words in the Caaba passage are doubtful. Printed text marked with * refers to the margin note on red agate.
